name: Shikijou Yuuki
source:
A person who is forced to participate in the game. She is a timid girl who hides behind [url=https://vndb.org/c24345]Souichi[/url] when frightened.

[spoiler]She has played and beaten the game multiple times, as such she's developed several survival techniques to help her win. After being violated by her single father long before the game, she has developed cynical ideals.

Assigned PDA card: 9, Joker(Route 2)[/spoiler]
